semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all real numbers x, the function value at x plus 1 equals the function value at x.
quantifier_order: for all x in real numbers

variables.name: x
variables.role: input variable to the function f

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses; the equality is asserted uniformly for each x

statement_nl: For every real number x, f(x + 1) = f(x).
